questions.stem: Find the largest integer x for which 2x + 1 < 10.

hint.level_0: Solve as an equation first, then step down to the largest whole number that still works.

questions.solution: Step 1 — 2x < 10−1 = 9 ⇒ x < 9/2. Step 2 — Largest integer x = 4.

questions.stem: Find the largest integer x for which 3x + 2 < 20.

hint.level_0: Solve as an equation first, then step down to the largest whole number that still works.

questions.solution: Step 1 — 3x < 20−2 = 18 ⇒ x < 18/3. Step 2 — Largest integer x = 5.

questions.stem: Find the largest integer x for which 4x + 3 < 27.

hint.level_0: Solve as an equation first, then step down to the largest whole number that still works.

questions.solution: Step 1 — 4x < 27−3 = 24 ⇒ x < 24/4. Step 2 — Largest integer x = 5.

questions.stem: Find the largest integer x for which 5x + 1 < 26.

hint.level_0: Solve as an equation first, then step down to the largest whole number that still works.

questions.solution: Step 1 — 5x < 26−1 = 25 ⇒ x < 25/5. Step 2 — Largest integer x = 4.

questions.stem: Find the largest integer x for which 2x + 5 < 19.

hint.level_0: Solve as an equation first, then step down to the largest whole number that still works.

questions.solution: Step 1 — 2x < 19−5 = 14 ⇒ x < 14/2. Step 2 — Largest integer x = 6.

questions.stem: Find the smallest integer x for which 3x + 2 > 14.

hint.level_0: Solve the equality, then step up to the next whole number.

questions.solution: Step 1 — 3x > 14−2 = 12 ⇒ x > 12/3. Step 2 — Smallest integer x = 5.

questions.stem: Find the smallest integer x for which 2x + 1 > 9.

hint.level_0: Solve the equality, then step up to the next whole number.

questions.solution: Step 1 — 2x > 9−1 = 8 ⇒ x > 8/2. Step 2 — Smallest integer x = 5.

questions.stem: Find the smallest integer x for which 4x + 0 > 20.

questions.solution: Step 1 — 4x > 20−0 = 20 ⇒ x > 20/4. Step 2 — Smallest integer x = 6.

questions.stem: Find the smallest integer x for which 5x + 3 > 28.

questions.solution: Step 1 — 5x > 28−3 = 25 ⇒ x > 25/5. Step 2 — Smallest integer x = 6.

questions.stem: How many positive integers x satisfy 3x < 20?

hint.level_0: Find the largest x that works; that is also the count starting from 1.

questions.solution: Step 1 — x < 20/3, so x = 1,2,…,6. Step 2 — Count = 6.
